verdict.rationale: Requesty's first-party structured-outputs docs say every supported model can return JSON, from json_object mode up to strict, schema-enforced json_schema mode. They also promise consistent behavior regardless of the underlying provider, which directly covers the cross-provider story. The prompt library can additionally store structured output formats. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of schema enforcement across providers, and documented per-provider limitations or edge cases (e.g., how it behaves with streaming or with providers lacking native schema support).

support.subject: As a developer, I can request structured JSON-schema outputs across providers

citations.quote: Requesty makes every supported model speak structured JSON — from simple json_object mode to strict, schema-enforced json_schema mode. One API, consistent behavior, regardless of the underlying provider.
